sahneler.metin: On the carrier Enterprise off Hawaii, a rocket exploded under a jet's wing.
Fire and explosions ripped across the deck, and twenty eight sailors died.
A tractor unit used to start aircraft was parked nearby.
Its exhaust heated a Zuni rocket.
The warhead exploded, igniting jet fuel.
More rockets exploded, blowing holes in the deck.
Burning fuel poured into the levels below.
Training after an earlier carrier fire helped limit the damage.

aciklama:
USS Enterprise exploded and burned off Hawaii. The cause: a Zuni rocket cooking off, igniting fuel and setting off further munitions.

#shorts #engineering #firesafety
